pages.title: Gastroenterology consult and colonoscopy
pages.text:
## GASTROENTEROLOGY CONSULT / PROCEDURE NOTE
Date: 10/18/2026 13:30
Consultant: Oren Takahashi, MD (Gastroenterology)
Procedure: Colonoscopy after bowel prep
Findings: Extensive sigmoid and descending colon diverticulosis. No active bleeding. No stigmata of recent hemorrhage requiring intervention. No masses, no colitis.
Upper endoscopy not indicated (no hematemesis, BUN not elevated).
Impression: Diverticular bleed, self-limited. No ulcer disease. No varices.
Recommendations: High fiber diet. Avoid NSAIDs. Outpatient GI follow-up in 4-6 weeks. OK for discharge from GI standpoint if Hgb stable.
Signed: Oren Takahashi, MD
